title: Correct deceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the deceleration as 7 m/s² using a = μ g.

title: Correct initial speed
description: Essential: The response must state or calculate the initial braking speed as 14 m/s using kinematics.

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate friction force (μ mg) to deceleration (ma) to find a.

title: Apply correct kinematic equation
description: Important: The solution must use v₀² = 2 a x (or equivalent) for uniform deceleration to rest.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if acceleration is given as positive when describing deceleration, or if speed/direction signs are inconsistent in equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award if all quantities (distance, g, μ, a, v) are handled with consistent units (m, s) throughout.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Award for clearly showing the steps v₀ = √(2 a x) and a = μ g without arithmetic errors.
